URL: https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/gcc/houthi-red-sea-blockade-would-lift-oil-prices-but-workarounds-could-limit-impact-403477
Reuters via Zawya, 21 Jul 2026 — Houthi shutting Bab el-Mandeb would remove critical alt route to Hormuz. Oil rose <1% after Houthi statement to ~$89; futures peaked at $126 this year (below 2008's $147). John Paisie (Stratas Advisors): oil could climb $115-120/bbl; "undermines the whole global economy. At some point, you could have a global recession." European diesel margins hit record >$65/bbl. Bab el-Mandeb carried 7.4m bpd in June (~7% global oil, Kpler). Saudi diverts 70%+ crude to Yanbu (~4.5m bpd, UBS) since Hormuz closure.
